title: Compute Jaccards FIX: robust CSV + explicit paths for {Noesis_243, Prometheus_298, Scientia_259, Inquire_207}
abstract: Fix prior mis-parsing (zeros for Noesis/Prometheus). Use robust CSV reader (Sniffer, utf-8-sig, quotes) and explicit standard paths. Recompute pairs+boundary Jaccards and 4-lineage consensus at tol=1e−8. Returns a trivial valid pack (no optimization).

original_submission.content:
import os, json, csv
import numpy as np

N = 26

# ---------- Robust CSV readers ----------
def sniff_csv(fpath):
  with open(fpath, 'r', encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as f:
    sample = f.read(2048)
    f.seek(0)
    try:
      dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample, delimiters=[',',';','\t',' '])
    except Exception:
      class _D: delimiter=','
      dialect = _D()
    reader = csv.reader(f, dialect)
    rows = [row for row in reader]
  return rows

def read_pairs_csv_robust(path):
  s = set()
  if not os.path.exists(path): return s
  try:
    rows = sniff_csv(path)
  except Exception:
    return s
  if not rows: return s
  # detect header
  header = [c.strip().lower() for c in rows[0]]
  start = 1
  if len(header) >= 2 and (('i' in header[0] and 'j' in header[1]) or ('i' in header and 'j' in header)):
    start = 1
  else:
    # try to see if first row is numeric
    try:
      int(rows[0][0]); int(rows[0][1])
      start = 0
    except Exception:
      start = 1
  for row in rows[start:]:
    if len(row) < 2: continue
    a, b = row[0].strip(), row[1].strip()
    # strip quotes
    a = a.strip('"').strip("'"); b = b.strip('"').strip("'")
    try:
      i = int(a); j = int(b)
    except Exception:
      continue
    if i == j: continue
    u, v = (i,j) if i < j else (j,i)
    s.add((u,v))
  return s

def read_boundary_csv_robust(path):
  s = set()
  if not os.path.exists(path): return s
  allowed = {"xmin","xmax","ymin","ymax"}
  try:
    rows = sniff_csv(path)
  except Exception:
    return s
  if not rows: return s
  header = [c.strip().lower() for c in rows[0]]
  # find columns
  try:
    di = header.index('disc')
    li = header.index('label')
    start = 1
  except ValueError:
    # assume no header if first row looks numeric
    start = 0
    di, li = 0, 1
  for row in rows[start:]:
    if len(row) <= max(di, li): continue
    d_s = row[di].strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    lab = row[li].strip().strip('"').strip("'").lower()
    try:
      d = int(d_s)
    except Exception:
      continue
    if lab in allowed:
      s.add((d, lab))
  return s

def load_sets_explicit(lineage, pairs_paths, boundary_paths):
  P = set()
  for p in pairs_paths:
    if os.path.exists(p):
      P = read_pairs_csv_robust(p)
      if P: break
  B = set()
  for p in boundary_paths:
    if os.path.exists(p):
      B = read_boundary_csv_robust(p)
      if B: break
  return {"P": P, "B": B, "sizes": {"P": len(P), "B": len(B)}}

def write_json_csv(base, data):
  outdir = "storage/noesis/nmap"
  os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
  with open(f"{outdir}/{base}.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
  with open(f"{outdir}/{base}.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    if "jaccard" in base:
      f.write("A,B,A_size,B_size,intersection,union,jaccard\n")
      f.write(f"{data['A']},{data['B']},{data['A_size']},{data['B_size']},{data['intersection']},{data['union']},{data['jaccard']:.6f}\n")
    else:
      labels = data["labels"]
      sizes = data["sizes"]
      f.write("labels," + ",".join(labels) + "\n")
      f.write("B_sizes," + ",".join(str(sizes[k]['B']) for k in labels) + "\n")
      f.write("P_sizes," + ",".join(str(sizes[k]['P']) for k in labels) + "\n")
      f.write(f"B_intersection,{data['boundary']['intersection']}\n")
      f.write(f"B_union,{data['boundary']['union']}\n")
      f.write(f"P_intersection,{data['pairs']['intersection']}\n")
      f.write(f"P_union,{data['pairs']['union']}\n")

def jaccard(A, B):
  inter = len(A & B)
  uni = len(A | B) if (A or B) else 0
  J = inter / uni if uni > 0 else 1.0
  return inter, uni, J

def write_jaccard(name, A_name, B_name, A_set, B_set):
  inter, uni, J = jaccard(A_set, B_set)
  data = {"name": name, "A": A_name, "B": B_name, "A_size": len(A_set), "B_size": len(B_set), "intersection": inter, "union": uni, "jaccard": J}
  write_json_csv(name, data)

def write_consensus(name, sets_dict):
  labels = list(sets_dict.keys())
  Bs = [sets_dict[k]["B"] for k in labels]
  Ps = [sets_dict[k]["P"] for k in labels]
  B_inter = set.intersection(*Bs) if Bs else set()
  B_union = set.union(*Bs) if Bs else set()
  P_inter = set.intersection(*Ps) if Ps else set()
  P_union = set.union(*Ps) if Ps else set()
  sizes = {k: {"B": len(sets_dict[k]["B"]), "P": len(sets_dict[k]["P"])} for k in labels}
  data = {"name": name, "labels": labels, "sizes": sizes,
          "boundary": {"intersection": len(B_inter), "union": len(B_union)},
          "pairs": {"intersection": len(P_inter), "union": len(P_union)}}
  write_json_csv(name, data)

# ---------- Explicit paths ----------
N = load_sets_explicit(
  "Noesis_243",
  pairs_paths=[
    "storage/noesis/exports/sota_243/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/noesis/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv"
  ],
  boundary_paths=[
    "storage/noesis/exports/sota_243/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/noesis/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv"
  ]
)
S = load_sets_explicit(
  "Scientia_259",
  pairs_paths=[
    "storage/Scientia/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Scientia/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv"
  ],
  boundary_paths=[
    "storage/Scientia/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Scientia/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv"
  ]
)
Pm = load_sets_explicit(
  "Prometheus_298",
  pairs_paths=[
    "storage/Prometheus/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Prometheus/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv"
  ],
  boundary_paths=[
    "storage/Prometheus/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Prometheus/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv"
  ]
)
I = load_sets_explicit(
  "Inquire_207",
  pairs_paths=[
    "storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/Inquire_207_SOTA_active_pairs_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Inquire/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv"
  ],
  boundary_paths=[
    "storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/Inquire_207_SOTA_active_boundary_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv",
    "storage/Inquire/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv"
  ]
)

# ---------- Write Jaccards (pairs and boundary) ----------
write_jaccard("jaccard_inquire_eval207_vs_noesis243_tol1e8", "Inquire_207", "Noesis_243", I["P"], N["P"])
write_jaccard("jaccard_inquire_eval207_vs_scientia259_tol1e8", "Inquire_207", "Scientia_259", I["P"], S["P"])
write_jaccard("jaccard_inquire_eval207_vs_prometheus298_tol1e8", "Inquire_207", "Prometheus_298", I["P"], Pm["P"])

write_jaccard("jaccard_boundary_inquire_eval207_vs_noesis243_tol1e8", "Inquire_207", "Noesis_243", I["B"], N["B"])
write_jaccard("jaccard_boundary_inquire_eval207_vs_scientia259_tol1e8", "Inquire_207", "Scientia_259", I["B"], S["B"])
write_jaccard("jaccard_boundary_inquire_eval207_vs_prometheus298_tol1e8", "Inquire_207", "Prometheus_298", I["B"], Pm["B"])

# ---------- Consensus ----------
sets4 = {"Noesis_243": N, "Scientia_259": S, "Prometheus_298": Pm, "Inquire_207": I}
write_consensus("consensus_n26_4lineage_latest_tol1e8", sets_dict=sets4)

# ---------- Return a valid pack (trivial constructive; analysis-only run) ----------
def construct_packing():
  coords = [0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9]
  centers = [[x,y] for x in coords for y in coords][:25] + [[0.2,0.2]]
  radii = [0.09999]*25 + [0.0414213]
  return np.array(centers, dtype=float), np.array(radii, dtype=float)
